page_title: Swapjutsu: Free Character Swap for Mac, No Watermark

sources.entry: Swapjutsu - Open-source character swap tool for videos with Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate, with on-device preparation on Apple silicon. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jutsuhq/swapjutsu-seedance-character-swap) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Swapjutsu
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Mac app that swaps the character in a video while keeping the original moves, camera and timing, rendering through Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate.
use_cases: replace a person in a video with a different character
swap several people in a clip and move them to a new location
draft low-cost AI video swaps before a full render
run character swaps for free on a personal ComfyUI GPU
let an AI agent prepare and render video clips
summary.what_it_does: Swapjutsu detects cuts, builds masks, tracks subjects, and estimates pose and depth on the Mac, producing a control video and prompt locally. Only the final render is sent out: to Seedance 2.5 via Comfy's API, or to a user's own ComfyUI running Wan 2.2 Animate. It replaces a whole person or several people while keeping the original motion and camera, unlike face-swap tools that only change the face. It includes an MCP server so agents such as Claude Code can prepare and render clips within a daily budget the user sets. The page lists a 7-second 480p Seedance draft at $1.19 and says the app shows the price before sending anything.
notable: Preparation runs offline on the Mac; only the render goes to the cloud
Free Wan 2.2 Animate route on your own ComfyUI with no per-render cost
Ships an MCP server for AI agents with a daily spending budget
MIT-licensed on GitHub; signed and notarized, 11 MB app
caveats: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 15 or later; Windows and Linux use the separate Kawarimi app
Seedance renders are paid through Comfy; the free route needs your own capable GPU and ComfyUI setup
Not made by or affiliated with Higgsfield or Viggle
